I would like you to implement a module named TopModule with the following
interface. All input and output ports are one bit unless otherwise
specified.

 - input  x (4 bits)
 - output f

below.

             x[0]x[1]
x[2]x[3]  00  01  11  10
  00     | 1 | 0 | 0 | 1 |
  01     | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
  11     | 1 | 1 | 1 | 0 |
  10     | 1 | 1 | 0 | 1 |

","interface":{"top":"TopModule","ports":[{"name":"x","direction":"input","width":4,"signed":false},{"name":"f","direction":"output","width":1,"signed":false}]},"constraints":"SystemVerilog, exactly one self-contained TopModule DUT.                ( x[3] &  x[2] &  x[1] & x[0]);
